text:
leah-sales: flagging a renewal conversation with Orchid Health. they blew past the annual commit (1.2M) during Q1 due to new feature rollout and want a reprice for the renewal. asking for a 22% rate concession + ability to downscale with 30 days notice. thoughts?
drew-se: curious what patterns look like. is this sustained or a one-off spike from a new product? also are they on Dedicated or Hosted?
leah-sales: Dedicated, 12-GPU reservation. CS says traffic is steady now; it's core to their product. they want lower $/embedding and removal of minimum monthly invoice for the first 2 months of renewal.
nina-cs: they've been high-touch; retention likely. customer asked about credits for the overage months too. they offered an 18-month renewal if we give pricing relief.
deal-desk: concessions note: >20% needs VP approval. removing minimum invoice and shortened notice are legal/ops-impacting. need ARR churn projections and impact on GPU pool allocation.
mike-ops: 30-day downscale for Dedicated is risky — fragmentation + rebalancing costs. if we allow 30-day, require migration window where non-critical jobs move to Hosted or burstable pools. also quantify potential reclaim cost. ops recommends a guardrail: 30-day only if they accept automated workload migration and a 6-week degrade schedule.
tara-legal: legal ok to draft conditional clause but want clarity on "credits" scope. retroactive credits require finance signoff. we'll need to define "overage" thresholds and cap.
pricing-bot: auto: historical ARR 1.2M, current QoQ usage +250%. suggested tie-breakers: (a) tiered discount model (10% @ commit, +5% @ 1.5x usage, +7% @ 2x) or (b) fixed 15% + 18-month commit + limited credits (max 1 month).
drew-se: technical note: to hit lower $/token without hurting perf we can: 1) add KV prefix cache for high-frequency routes, 2) route lower-critical inference to quantized variants, 3) enable smart batching during their 9pm-2am peak. will need config changes and smoke tests.
leah-sales: here's a negotiation plan I'll bring: Option 1 (short term): 15% discount, 12-month renewal, 1 month credit for overage, keep 90-day notice. Option 2 (agg commit): 20% discount if they sign 18-month and increase commit by 25%, allow 30-day downscale with automated migration.
deal-desk: include ROI for us: net revenue delta, expected retention %, and ops reclaim risk. if retention probability > 90% and commit increases we can escalate approval to Director level only.
tara-legal: draft clause suggestion: "Customer may request accelerated downscale (30 days) only where (i) Customer executes an 18-month committed spend amendment and (ii) agrees to a defined workload migration playbook. Retroactive credits limited to a single month and capped at X% of quarterly invoice." send final numbers.
leah-sales: action items: Drew -> technical mitigation plan + config diff; Deal-desk -> economics worksheet; Tara -> legal clause draft; Mike -> ops cost estimate for fragmentation. I'll update before Tue renewal call. ETA Mon EOD. :rocket:
